messages:
Lina Patel: Quick heads-up — we need to lock GPU headroom for the Nov–Feb winter surge. Product usage forecasts + marketing promos expected to push Dedicated pool QPS up ~35%.
Mike Chen: timeline? are we asking cloud quota increases or doing reservations (savings plans / committed use)?
Lina Patel: Both. Short term: quota increases in target regions (us-west2, eu-west1). Medium term: reserve a small committed capacity for Dedicated pools to get pricing predictability. Need to open quota tickets this week.
Samir Rao: Forecast snapshot from infra: weekly peak vtoken throughput -> estimated GPU hours.
Samir Rao: Forecast summary:
- Current steady: 320 A100-80GB-hours/day
- Expected peak (Nov–Jan): 430 A100-80GB-hours/day (+34%)
- Burst headroom target: +25% of peak => ~540 A100-80GB-hours/day capacity
Samir Rao: That maps to ~18 A100-80GB instances sustained with 6-hour rotations, or 12 H100s if we mix for latency-sensitive routes.
Aya Gomez: Region constraints: us-west2 has limited H100 quota currently; support already flagged that new quota approval could take 7–10 days. EU likely faster but networking (ENI/IP) limits might need bumping too.
Priya Kapoor: Cost sanity check: ballpark reserved monthly for 18 A100 equiv = $~146k/month list, with committed could get ~25% off. We should pick a reserve that covers 60–70% of forecasted peak and rely on burst + autoscale for the rest.
Mike Chen: For cloud requests we need exact quota numbers and justification. Can someone draft the AWS/GCP quota payloads? I can file the support tickets once we have numbers.
Lina Patel: I'll draft. Proposal: request in us-west2 & eu-west1:
- GPUs (A100-80GB) quota increase: +20 -> want total 60
- GPUs (H100) quota increase: +8 -> want total 16
- ENIs per region: +200
- Static IPs / reserved IPs: +100
- vCPU limit: +640
- Regional firewall rules: increase concurrent rules from 50 -> 100 for inference LB
Samir Rao: +1 on those numbers. Also ask for a soft limit for preemptible/spot GPU instances for burst traffic (so our autoscaler can spin up cheaper capacity when needed).
Aya Gomez: Example GCP quota request body (paste this in support ticket):
```json
{
  "project": "redwood-prod-dedicated",
  "region": "us-west2",
  "quotas": [
    {"metric": "NVIDIA_A100_80GB_GPUS", "desired": 60},
    {"metric": "NVIDIA_H100_GPUS", "desired": 16},
    {"metric": "VCPU", "desired": 3200}
  ],
  "justification": "Dedicated inference capacity for Q4 surge: support low-latency hosted and dedicated customers; mixing A100/H100 for cost/latency balance. Expect +34% usage over baseline."
}
```
Priya Kapoor: Finance asks that we include committed spend options and expected monthly delta. I'll attach the cost model to the ticket before filing.
quota-bot: :information_source: Support ticket draft saved -> https://support.cloud-provider.example/ticket/RED-1791 (auto-generated, please review before submit)
Mike Chen: Let's also open an internal change request for network team to pre-open firewall and subnet expansion PRs. Last-minute network changes hurt rollout.
Lina Patel: Agreed. Action items:
- Lina to finalize quota numbers and justification (today)
- Mike to file cloud support tickets + add finance cost attachments (tomorrow)
- Samir to prepare autoscaler policy tweaks and burst-spot config (end of week)
- Aya to queue network limits change request and coordinate with cloud rep (ASAP)
Priya Kapoor: Approving provisional committed spend up to $120k/month for the next 3 months pending final CFO sign-off.
Lina Patel: Thanks — I’ll post the final ticket links here once submitted. If anyone has objections to the numbers, flag now. :thumbsup:
